title: Binyamin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was appointed over the ovens in the Temple, as in Tosefta Shekalim, chapter 2, halakha 14.[^1]

notes.text: The Mechon Mamre digital text of Tosefta Shekalim chapter 2 explicitly lists Binyamin over the ovens. Hyman’s chapter 2, halakhah 14 locator and Temple-office description are retained, without adding the list’s other officials or an identity connection.
